Happy to help you sort these. A quick framework based on what you've told me (a summer 2026 analyst internship in the Bay Area):

| Listing | Skills you'd build | Why it might rank high | Watch out for |
|---|---|---|---|
| A: Transportation analyst | Excel/SQL, route optimization, dashboards | Most hands-on analytics, very concrete resume bullets | Smaller company, may have fewer return-offer pipelines |
| B: Medical device supply chain | Demand planning, forecasting | Well-known industry, structured intern programs | Often very competitive |
| C: 3PL logistics analyst | Slotting, labor planning, warehouse ops | Operational, plenty of quantifiable results | Can be more floor-based than desk-based |

My suggestion: prioritize A first if you want the strongest analytics story, then B for brand and structure, with C as the solid backup. If you tell me which skills you most want to grow, I can adjust the ranking.

Since you're logging two in your tracker tonight, I'd add A and B and put a deadline column with a buffer.
